sources.name: Microsoft Rocketbox Avatar Library
sources.notes: Public repository archived 2026-10-02; multi-GB and source assets are not GLB-ready. Keep license notice when distributing. Partial source acquisition 2026-11-13: four archived model ZIPs (medical FBX-only), two sample animation FBXs in one archive; exact Drive IDs confined to private receipt; GLB conversion initially failed due missing Blender numpy and is not yet validated. Two GLBs in Drive passed actual WebGL2/Three.js r185 loader, mixer, rendered triangles and reload checks; not fully released.

archived_2026_11_13.browser_qa: Three.js 185 GLTFLoader, 80 bones, textures, two clips, mixer, render, dispose/reload passed; visual/mobile/long-session review pending
